correctness.rationale: Exact Gaussian conditional-risk identity, independently integrated closed G expression, rigorous one-switch derivative F and exact sign formula G''+2aG'=a^(-1)(exp(-2at)-exp(-2a(1-t))) imply a unique global stationary point after midpoint for every a,eta>0. The inverse noise-response derivative is strictly positive on this branch; implicit expansion establishes the high-noise rate, and uniform covariance convergence gives the Brownian limit. Four symbolic identities and 60 numeric checks replayed directly from verify.py; none are used as proof of uncountable-parameter statements.

value.rationale: A natural, complete one-observation trajectory-recovery design across a continuum of mean-reversion and measurement-noise regimes. The exact unique optimizer is provably past the midpoint and approaches an interior time at arbitrarily large noise; that contrasts with the Brownian high-noise endpoint limit. The sign-switch identity is an interpretable structural criterion rather than arbitrary computation or a known-table value.
